All unmentioned identity, security, funds, return/onward bookings, health and departure checks are stipulated satisfied. Only the documents and facts shown or obtainable through the offered checks are available. Unless expressly identified, the traveller has an ordinary passport, no additional citizenship, no destination residence, special passport, crew, e-Channel or other exemption. Short tourism only; no work. Routine entry permissions for an untested leg are not silently assumed when that leg is part of the puzzle.

Air Beluga training procedure (fictional carrier policy): complete the offered checks. Escalate a material eligibility, identity or transfer conflict that remains unresolved after those checks; deny a confirmed requirement failure once relevant obtainable alternatives are excluded. Unfamiliarity alone is insufficient. No live airline or government systems are called.

questions.response: The current-passport registration claim cannot be confirmed from the available record or issuer response. No Japanese visa or other exemption is available.

rationale: An Indonesian electronic passport requires qualifying registration; an old booklet receipt does not establish registration of the replacement. The current registration claim remains specifically unresolved after verification. Escalate under fictional Air Beluga procedure instead of assuming approval or a definitive absence of registration.
